subject: Charter Financial Procedures
overview: The Article 6 Subcommittee reviewed draft charter language regarding Medford's financial procedures, focusing on budget timelines, capital planning schedules, and audit oversight. The committee also considered whether to conduct further research into proposed City Council budget reallocation powers.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the approval of minutes until an additional member arrived.

items.title: City Council Budget Reallocation Amendment
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed researching a proposed amendment to allow the City Council to reallocate budget funds, agreeing to ask the full committee whether to reopen the matter.

items.title: Article 6 Financial Procedures Draft
items.summary: Members agreed to draft provisions establishing a 60-to-100-day pre-fiscal-year budget meeting, a three-year capital improvement cycle, and City Council oversight of independent audits, while reserving questions on budget adoption deadlines for the Collins Center.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the prior meeting.
